changes.title: Animal growth
items: Bear cubs, otter pups, beaver kits, baby dormice, toadlets and mole pups now look like babies (round, big-eyed, short-legged; the mole pup pink, the toadlet all head and eyes), and the young are lanky or slim, growing into the adults rather than being small copies of them

changes.title: Tree mains
items: The misty terraces grow wild cherry among their firs, in rows along the ledges
Larches now stand along the pack ice's shore with the firs and birch, and frost-pale whitebeams in the frost cave
The mangrove pools' trees ring the water, the mossy creek's cedars line the creek, the penguin rookery's trees ring the nests, and the erg's date palms ring their oasis
The bamboo jungle grows thicker; the temple jungle's and the frost cave's trees stand apart

changes.title: Rattlesnake scorpion
items: Two new animals for the badlands islands: the rattlesnake, sidewinding across the cactus flats and rattling its warning when you come near, and the scorpion, out on the red canyon's rocks under the moon
Their legends: an ancient horned rattlesnake on great coils whose rattle ripples the sand, and an elder scorpion carrying its young on its back, glowing blue-green at its seams
